kids_evidence: Store category PRODUCTIVITY (agl-manifest/store/apps/AGrammarly.json:28); Kids Category audit row 'not applicable: none of [kids] detected' (docs/store-policy/AGrammarly.md:39); spec user is adults answering personal/work messages (ai-office/projects/real-apps/specs/AGrammarly.md:49).

banner.where: none - no google_mobile_ads/agl_ads in mobile/pubspec.yaml (grep: no hit), no GADApplicationIdentifier in mobile/ios/Runner/Info.plist, no APPLICATION_ID in mobile/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml. Recommended slot if integrated: footer of the Library list, mobile/lib/features/library/library_screen.dart (after the ListView.separated at :206), not on the Reply Desk where the ReplyPad docks under the editor.

interstitial.why: Not present (no SDK). Do not add one: the app is a quick, task-focused reply tool (paste message, pick reply, copy) - the founder rule says utilities in quick sessions get no interstitial.

native.why: The only scrolling list is Library (mobile/lib/features/library/library_screen.dart:206-210 ListView.separated over SavedReply), which is the user's own private saved replies, not content/listings. An ad among private messages is a poor fit and contradicts the app's privacy pitch. No feed exists.

rewarded.why: No free quota or premium feature exists to extend: the reply engine runs on-device with no cost per answer, and the old isPremium code is dead and slated for deletion (specs/AGrammarly.md:30, :122). Nothing honest to reward.

blockers: RECOMMENDATION: integrate AdMob banner-only in the container app (Library footer), but this needs a founder decision: the spec explicitly says 'Ads. The app has no ad SDK and stays that way.' (specs/AGrammarly.md:242), and the in-app About copy says 'There is no analytics and no advertising.' (mobile/lib/features/about/about_screen.dart:66-70), which must be rewritten in the same change.
